definition: The quality of having few wants.

example_phrases.translation: talk on fewness of wishes, on contentment, on seclusion, on non-entanglement
example_phrases.notes: From the ten topics of worthwhile talk in MN 122. The record previously cited AN 4.27, which is titled Santuṭṭhi but speaks of being content with `what is trifling and easy to get` and contains no form of `appicchatā`. MN 122 is not a translated surface, so the record stays orphaned. Repaired in the 2026-09-13 Wave 11 audit.
